name: Seahorse Coffee
notes: All 3 photos are the same printed sandwich-board menu shot at different exposures (photo 1 dim, photos 2-3 clearer); merged into one item set. Each drink/food line lists 2-3 sizes; the smallest listed price is used. 'Eats' section is real food (pastries, bagels, yogurt/acai/granola bowls, oatmeal, panini); the rest is coffee, tea and smoothie drinks, kept in since this is a coffee shop's actual menu, not an alcohol-only tap/wine list.
